purpose: Describe observed parking reconstructed from gaps between usable drives, with explicit location quality, observation limits and censoring.
primaryGoal: Understand where, when and how long the selected vehicle parks within the workspace window without confusing inferred dwell with continuously observed occupancy.

dataSources.behavior: Query key includes selected vehicle, start, end and bounded limit; request receives AbortSignal, select uses safeArray, query is disabled without vehicle and uses STALE_TIMES.FAST.
dataSources.limitations: Router registration verified from source only. Backend handler/query implementation, ordering, exact filter behavior and network responses were not exercised. Newest-first/UTC semantics are stated by the parking model and caveats, not independently certified here.

dataSources.sourceOwner: Existing workspace selection, range preferences and date-format hooks
dataSources.behavior: Uses vehicleId, display timezone tz and start/end dates. /parking is range-enabled at workspaceScope.ts:54; getWorkspaceRouteScope at lines 154-167 also enables the vehicle control. No duplicate page selector.
dataSources.limitations: The page does not consume the range hook's precise instant bounds; see scope finding.

dataSources.behavior: Frozen injected page clock; UTC-date validation; display-timezone local hour/weekday/month/night split; invalid/open/overlapping/zero gaps counted; deterministic location and stint rankings; final tail right-censored; possible 1000-row truncation disclosed.
dataSources.siContract: Drive.durationS remains seconds. Internal timestamp/dwell arithmetic uses milliseconds; renderers divide by 1000 before formatDuration/convertDurationFromSI. No wire/cache conversion proposed.

dataSources.behavior: Historical provenance, fatal-only error gate, retained refresh warning and source-backed numeric operational metrics. Units and numbers are formatted at the display boundary.

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-002 / mission 4: avoid competing summary renderers
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Barrel exports ParkingKpiBand (index.ts:6), but the mounted page uses VehicleEvidenceBrief. The alternate component duplicates all four headline metrics and parking-kpis/parking-summary identities, formats percentages/duration as text metrics and gates the entire band on loading/error.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Keep the mounted numeric VehicleEvidenceBrief as canonical. Before retiring the alternate export, perform a bounded caller check; do not re-adopt the text-metric implementation or remove sections.
duplicatedPatterns.confidence: high for duplication; alternate callers unverified

duplicatedPatterns.rule: MDC-031 / mission 7: hierarchy rather than repeated chrome
duplicatedPatterns.detail: Coverage title appears in PanelTitle and again in the nested evidence brief at line 75, whose description repeats the headline brief description. Existing information is useful, but repeated titles/chrome add emphasis.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Use one visible section heading while retaining the brief's accessible title, all coverage metrics, review action, provenance and complete caveats. Reuse existing surface/embedded contracts, not a new card.
duplicatedPatterns.confidence: high source; rendered visual impact unverified

responsive.sourceBehavior: Top-level duration/overnight and location/longest pairs stack until xl. Temporal pair stacks below lg. Tables explicitly hide non-primary columns below md. No viewport exercised.

findings.detail: One fixed 420px outer viewport contains a one-column, two-row grid until lg (line 126). Each child becomes 256px tall at sm (ParkingStartBarChart.tsx:68), before headings/gap/embedded-frame overhead; the two plots alone exceed 420px at 640-1023px. ChartContainer clips its viewport (ChartContainer.tsx:668).
findings.fix: Give the stacked temporal composition sufficient owned height or use the existing fluid chart contract with an explicitly sized responsive host; keep both charts, headings and combined accessible/export data. Verify 640-1023px and allocated narrow containers, not just viewport labels.
findings.confidence: high source geometry risk; actual clipping unverified

findings.rule: MDC-023 / MDC-043: mobile must retain specialist details
findings.detail: mobileColumns includes rank/location/durationMs only: parked-at and censoring status are hidden below md. TopParkingLocations.tsx:160 similarly hides stint count and share. DataTable.tsx:724-725 enforces hidden md:table-cell; neither caller supplies mobilePresentation or expanded detail rendering.
findings.fix: Adopt existing DataTable mobilePresentation with typed displayValue, roles and allDetails for all columns, or an existing expansion contract. Preserve ongoing/range-edge status and complete location labels on touch, while retaining table IDs, filters, pagination and export ownership.

responsive.requiredValidation: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560 plus 640-1023px, narrow allocated grids, RTL, long destination names and 200% text.

accessibility.sourceStrengths: Localized section labels, hidden decorative icons, aria-labeled chart frames, accessible chart dataColumns, semantic shared typography, help accessible name and reduced-motion-aware FadeIn are present.

findings.detail: Hourly and weekday ParkingStartBarChart calls omit ariaLabel. Both default to the same generic 'Bar chart of Parking starts patterns' (ParkingStartBarChart.tsx:44-49), despite distinct visible subheadings.
findings.fix: Pass distinct localized hourly and weekday ariaLabel values through the existing prop, preserving each embedded data table and combined fallback table.

findings.rule: MDC-040 / mission 16: avoid hover-only full information
findings.detail: Destination labels truncate and rely on native title for the full value; LongestParkingStints.tsx:71-73 does the same. Neither table supplies an accessible/touch details presentation.
findings.fix: Expose full destinations in the existing mobile/detail presentation; preserve the visible compact summary and source string without recasing or shortening source data.
findings.confidence: high source; assistive technology behavior unverified

unverified: Focus restoration from review drawer/help/chart menus

states.loading: drivesQuery.isLoading drives brief and all seven section shells; shared charts and ParkingSectionBody own placeholders.
states.empty: All eight section identities remain mounted for a selected vehicle. Chart-specific explanations, table empty navigation and method caveats remain. Browse drives links target /drives.
states.fatalError: sectionState.error uses drivesState.fatalError; shared retry callback refetches the one source. Source metrics use null when drivesState.data is absent.
states.retainedRefreshFailure: StaleRefreshWarning remains above retained content; fatal-only section gates keep data mounted. Test source asserts this; tests were not executed.
states.noVehicle: Existing NoVehicleSelected branch; useDrives enabled=false without a selected ID.
states.partial: Potential cap is derived from returned count; coverage brief maps ok+capped to partial, but headline does not.
states.offline: Existing StaleRefreshWarning inspects isRefreshBlocked and preserves retained data; offline route behavior not exercised.

findings.rule: MDC-025 / MDC-026: unknown is not success
findings.detail: Badge is calculated before the loading/fatal body gate. Empty fallback summary yields possiblyCapped=false, so initial loading or failed initial fetch shows success 'Within request cap' even when hasSource=false.
findings.fix: Derive badge text/tone from actual hasSource/loading/fatal state before interpreting row-cap evidence. Use existing neutral/warning Badge variants; retain measured within-cap and potentially-capped meanings once source is known.

findings.rule: MDC-026: incomplete sample must stay explicit
findings.detail: Headline status passes drivesState.status unchanged while coverage maps ok+capped to partial (ParkingCoverageMethodology.tsx:77). A capped successful source can therefore read 'Source returned' at the top and partial only at the final section.
findings.fix: Carry a presentation-only partial sample status/context into the headline for capped successful data without changing query DataState, counts, cache, or inferred measurements; keep the specific cap caveat.

visualIssues.rule: MDC-010 / MDC-016 / mission 7: meaningful rather than decorative color
visualIssues.detail: Method paragraphs use emerald/cyan/amber/rose icon accents at lines 39,52,65,89; coverage title adds purple and table titles cyan/amber. Toned-down colors are not neon violations, but rainbow decoration competes with actual capped/censoring warnings.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing muted foreground for informational/title icons and reserve existing semantic warning color for actionable coverage/censoring states. Preserve all explanatory paragraphs and user-selected chart palettes.
visualIssues.confidence: high source styling; composed contrast/appearance unverified

visualIssues.detail: DataTable sits inside GlassPanel with no explicit embedded variant; LongestParkingStints.tsx:153 does the same. Existing DataTable supports variant='embedded' (DataTable.tsx:187-188).
visualIssues.fix: Use the existing embedded table variant if mounted review confirms repeated framing, preserving toolbar/column/paging/export capabilities and stable IDs.
visualIssues.confidence: medium; extra visible chrome not exercised

architectureIssues.rule: MDC-032 / MDC-045: precise shared workspace scope
architectureIssues.detail: Page sends start/end calendar strings to the server and UTC-date-only parking model rather than startInstant/endInstantExclusive. useRangeState.ts:656-668 computes rolling 24h/live instants and local calendar bounds; workspaceScope.ts:80 exposes 24h. Therefore the page cannot represent the header's precise rolling or timezone-aware calendar interval, even though it consumes the shared selector.
architectureIssues.fix: Integration change: consume authoritative shared timezone and instant bounds for both useDrives and parking reconstruction; extend the pure model's range contract coherently, preserve UTC-date compatibility where intentionally required, and update misleading UTC-only descriptions/tests. Do not merely pass RFC3339 into parseParkingUtcRange, which accepts only date strings.
architectureIssues.confidence: high source mismatch; server instant execution unverified

order: Align server and reconstruction interval with precise workspace scope.
Make mobile censoring/status/secondary details reachable and fix stacked temporal height.
Prevent unknown cap evidence from appearing successful and disclose capped headline sample.
Add distinct embedded chart names; reduce duplicate chrome and decorative icon color.
Reconcile alternate unmounted KPI renderer without losing capabilities.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Precise workspace parking interval integration
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse startInstant/endInstantExclusive/timezone and useDrives DriveWindow RFC3339 bounds. Parking model needs explicit numeric/exclusive bounds rather than UTC-date-only parsing; retain frozen-clock and censoring rules.
dependsOn: Existing workspace calendar/DST and rolling presets
requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: Integration-owned model/caller coordination, not a new range component or hook API.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Full mobile parking table presentation
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse DataTable.mobilePresentation: roles, displayValue(row,columnKey), allDetails(row), optional state/onRetry; existing details preserve hidden layout columns. Keep same table pipeline, IDs and loaded-row export/filter semantics.
requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: Page adoption only; no shared extension demonstrated.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Responsive composed temporal chart sizing
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse height/mobileHeight/fluid and EmbeddedChart's existing fluid contract; explicitly sized host must accommodate both charts and headings when stacked. Preserve loading/error/empty, named charts and accessible combined export table.
requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: Page layout correction; do not globally loosen chart overflow or add another frame.

competingImplementations.name: ParkingKpiBand versus mounted VehicleEvidenceBrief
competingImplementations.decision: Prefer mounted numeric evidence bridge. Alternate exported KPI band is not a ninth mounted section; caller retirement requires follow-up.

competingImplementations.name: No new shell, chart, stats, table or range system
competingImplementations.decision: Reuse existing owners; do not create a parking-specific design system.

preservation.lineCountContext: Source-only counts, no modernization delta. Alternate unmounted ParkingKpiBand adds one textual section/GlassPanel but not mounted coverage. Preserve decomposed domain sections rather than shrinking the page.
actions: Retry failed drive source from section QueryError surfaces.
Refresh retained stale/offline source through StaleRefreshWarning.
Review details in both operational briefs, including sample, source and missing reasons.
Browse drives from applicable empty states.
Existing chart data/export/fullscreen controls where enabled; export filenames parking-duration-distribution, parking-overnight-context, parking-temporal-profile and parking-monthly-dwell.
Toggle duration and monthly series with chartKey persistence parking-duration-distribution and parking-monthly-dwell.
DataTable loaded-row export, column/filter controls and location pagination as supplied by existing defaults.
Header-owned vehicle and workspace range controls.
data: Numeric SI drive duration and timestamp data remain raw through query/cache; physical conversion only at display boundary.
Frozen page clock persists across range-driven rerenders; do not silently turn observed tails into live continuously measured occupancy.
Invalid/future/open/overlapping/zero gaps and missing locations remain explicit; null unknowns do not become measured zero.
Parked share denominator is reconstructed parked plus tracked driving time, not total calendar-window occupancy.
Local night overlap and parking-start hour/weekday/month grouping, deterministic ranks, all duration bands, average monthly dwell export and location aggregation remain.
Retained successful data survives refresh failure; initial failure cannot fabricate metrics.
Possible row truncation remains disclosed; do not claim guaranteed complete/lifetime coverage.
Stable table IDs vehicles:parking-locations and vehicles:parking-longest, query identity, theme/unit/locale/motion preferences and source destination strings survive.
